claims.quote: Sand's cory, Hoplisoma davidsandsi, long known as Corydoras davidsandsi, is an armoured catfish apparently endemic to the rio Unini system in the lower rio Negro basin, Brazil.
Type locality is 'Rio Unini, whitewater area of the Rio Negro, Brazil', and this species appears endemic to that tributary system located within the lower rio Negro.
